caption: The video captures a lit candle flame centered against a uniform black background, with the pale-yellow wax rim visible at the bottom edge. It shows a bright white-yellow core, a soft reddish halo, and a small blue base region around a thin dark wick. The flame remains vertically oriented and roughly constant in height while flickering continuously. Its tip and body lean slightly to one side, curve briefly in opposite directions, and return to a fuller upright teardrop form. The width and sharpness of the luminous tip vary as the inner flame shifts shape. The reddish halo and blue base persist throughout, changing only slightly in intensity and extent. The candle base stays fixed in the frame as the burning flame continually deforms.
